candidate_pool.rule: rerankers only permute the 50 BM25 candidates; no removal, no additions; Recall@50 must equal BM25
candidate_pool.tie_break: SHA256(seed | query_id | evidence_id), seed from config/retrieval.yaml bm25.tie_break (time-blind)

recency.censoring_note: left-censored evidence (valid_from_censored=true) carries observed_from = window start; its observed age is a lower bound

diagnostic.name: recency_only
diagnostic.rule: sort the 50 candidates by observed_from descending (newest first); ties by the hash

main.name: bm25_recency
main.formula: score = minmax_bm25(e, q) + lambda * exp(-observed_age_days / tau)
main.bm25_normalization: min-max within the 50 candidates of the query; constant list -> 0
